name: What is the best type of tile to install on a garage floor?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of tile to install on a garage floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain tile is the most durable ceramic choice for garage floors because it handles heavy vehicle weights, chemical spills, and freeze-thaw cycles without cracking. Standard ceramic tile is softer and absorbs more moisture, making it prone to breaking under tires or during cold Colorado winters. A practical tradeoff is that porcelain is harder to cut and requires a modified thin-set mortar specifically rated to bond dense tiles to concrete. For heavy workshop or parking use, full-body porcelain with a textured, slip-resistant finish provides the best combination of strength and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is best for garage floors because its density handles vehicle weight, road salt, and temperature swings far better than standard ceramic tile.
